versions.title: Komaru Chatbot, Chess Web App Rework & User Command Enhancements
versions.description: Added the rule-based Komaru chatbot, reworked chess around the web app API with automatic role rewards, expanded user commands with persistence and interactive inputs, and improved audit logs, GitHub embeds, and deploy exclusions.

sections.title: Added
items: Rule-based Komaru the Cat chatbot (komaruChat) with mood, energy, hunger, and bond tracking via /chat, /komaru_mood, /komaru_interact, and /komaru_channel.
Automatic chess role rewards (/chess_roles) for first match, Elo tiers (stacked or highest-only), and #1 top player.
User command persistence (hide, think, expr), interactive user input (ask with regex validation), message/media groups, and /usercmd_persistence_limits & /usercmd_input_limit admin commands.
Audit log attachment re-uploads, image previews, metadata fields, and source channel links for deleted/spam/ghost-pinged messages.
Link-only <owner/repo#number> GitHub references and status-aware embed colors/labels (draft, merged, closed, duplicate, not planned).

sections.title: Changed
items: Reworked chess (/challenge, /accept, /chess, /chess_stats, /chess_leaderboard, /chess_mod) to use the external chess web app API with polling and auth codes.
Allowed moderators to enable and disable user commands via /usercmd_enable and /usercmd_disable.
Expanded deploy.ts and .gitignore exclusions to protect production guild configs and runtime state across all modules.

versions.title: Legacy Tag Conversion & Production Deployment Pipeline
versions.description: Changelog tracking introduced. Major updates to deployment infrastructure, quality gates, and legacy tag migration.

sections.title: Added
items: Changelog system and /changelog command with version inspection and historical release notes.
Legacy tag conversion command (/convert_legacy_tags) and migration engine converting legacy tags into rich user commands.
Production deployment pipeline (scripts/deploy.ts, deploy.sh, run-prod.sh) with strict multi-stage quality gates.

sections.title: Changed
items: Deployment pipeline configured to strictly exclude dev and test environment user commands from production targets.
Updated slash command synchronization and module loading diagnostics.

sections.title: Removed
items: Google Drive backup service and associated commands.
